What if the only gap between people is awareness?

Kevin explains that everyone is made of the same stuff. Some people are asleep and some are awake, and most do not realize what they hold in their hands.

He says that is the whole difference, whether someone becomes spiritually enlightened or wealthy. It comes down to being aware of who you really are.

What part of yourself have you not fully noticed yet?
